title: Falling for your best friend? Worth the talk.
old_caption:
Falling for your best friend and scared to say it?
Ask kindly, and you can keep the friend either way.

title: Cancers aren't clingy. They're loyal.
old_caption:
Sent nine texts because you got worried?
Cancer's lesson: say the need out loud, kindly, in one message.

title: Capricorns show love in calendars.
old_caption:
Does your partner say I love you with a planner?
Learn their accent. Capricorn wrote a whole Saturday just for you.

title: Splitting chores is a love language.
old_caption:
Is doing the dishes secretly romantic?
Virgo thinks splitting chores is a love language, and the stack proves it.

title: Coffee beats dinner for a first date.
old_caption:
Dreading a fancy first-date dinner?
Low pressure helps you actually talk. Start small, stay curious.

title: Dallas dresses up for brunch. Houston dresses for the heat.
old_caption:
Does your city decide how you dress for a date?
The stars say dress like you. Confidence is the outfit.

title: Astrology is a conversation starter, not a dealbreaker.
old_caption:
Only dating one element of the zodiac?
A sign tells you a vibe, a conversation tells you a person. Ask before you rule out.

title: In Houston, date outside your bubble.
old_caption:
Do you always date the same type in the same three places?
Pop the bubble. A new neighborhood can mean a new story.

title: Double texting is allowed.
old_caption:
Is sending a second text really that bad?
Gemini says text twice if you want. Just read the room after that.

title: Being friends with your ex? Usually no.
old_caption:
Still hugging your ex and calling it fine?
Friendship can work, but only once the door is truly closed for everyone.
